about_the_game:
A MEDIEVAL JOURNEY WITH A V8 ROAR

Ride your iron steed across vast battlefields and deadly arenas filled with traps and obstacles. Choose your class, build your war machine, and prove your mastery on the field.

Immerse yourself in a rich medieval-punk world where fantasy meets roaring engines and the arcane magic of the Aether.

ARENAS OF CHIVALRIC CARNAGE

In War of Wheels, the carnage unfolds in two thrilling modes:

Gladiatorial Arena: Enter a colosseum filled with traps and engage in fearsome one-on-one duels, where unpredictable magic and environmental hazards make every encounter unique.

Field Battle: Roam the world, ambush enemy factions, and take part in epic team skirmishes. Available during early access.

FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE WAR MACHINES

Five Classes. Infinite Honor. Choose your path to glory from five distinct car classes, each blending RPG archetypes with vehicular destruction:

  • The Knight: Heavily armored and unstoppable, built to tank damage and ram enemies into oblivion.

  • The Ranger: Agile and deadly at range, picking off foes with precision before they get close.

  • The Assassin: A master of stealth and speed, striking from the shadows when least expected.

  • The Barbarian: Pure, unadulterated aggression. High damage, high risk.

  • The Artificer: A master of technology and magic, controlling the battlefield with gadgets and Aether.

Unlock armor plates, spiked bumpers, and ether-infused upgrades to create a steed that is yours alone.

COUCH CO-OP CHAOS

Revive the glory days of split-screen gaming. Team up or settle grudges with friends in local multiplayer battles, compatible with Steam Remote Play.

KEY FEATURES

  • RPG CLASSES ON WHEELS: Don't just drive, play a role. The Knight tanks damage, the Assassin strikes from the shadows, and the Artificer controls the battlefield with Aether tech.

  • A VAST CONTINENT TO CONQUER: Drive your war machine through 4 unique biomes, from treacherous frozen tundras to ancient, fortified cities.

  • CHAOS CONTROL: Wreak havoc in dynamic colosseums where every structure can be destroyed, creating new traps and sightlines mid-battle.

JOIN THE RANKS! War of Wheels is in Early Access, meaning your battles and feedback shape the future of our medievalpunk world. Get immediate access to all 5 car classes and help us forge the Story Mode.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Most modern 64bit Linux distributions
  • Processor: Dual-Core 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 660 with latest proprietary drivers (not older than 6 months) / similar AMD with latest proprietary drivers (not older than 6 months; the minimum supported resolution for the game is 720p) with Vulkan support.
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 660 with latest proprietary drivers (not older than 6 months) / similar AMD with latest proprietary drivers (not older than 6 months; the minimum supported resolution for the game is 720p) with Vulkan support.
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Knights, metal and V8 Engines. War of Wheels is a frenetic "medievalpunk" car brawler where you drift, use giant axes, and smash opponents in a fight for glory. Choose your class, customize your Iron Steed, and bring chivalry to the asphalt.
